items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: I've had more drummers, you know, come in and look up like Krupa or Buddy Rich and those guys coming, they look up there and they're trying to figure out what I was doing

ctx.x: I play half and half. I play right-footed and left-handed. See, I originally started all left. See? And then, I don't know, it was more, my right leg was better. I could keep better time with the right leg than I could with the left. And then you didn't, we didn't have those flying horse things then, you know. And so I got, I don't know how I ever did it. Just all of a sudden I changed and put the, instead of putting the snare drum over on the left where it's supposed to be, I put it on the right so I could have…
